WITH matched AS (
  SELECT s.sentreg, t.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix, s.instownpct AS ownership
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s
  JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON s.transref = t.transreg
  WHERE t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL
    AND s.instownpct IS NOT NULL
), baselines AS (
  SELECT order_type_mix, AVG(ownership) AS mix_baseline
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY order_type_mix
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(ownership) AS overall_avg
  FROM matched
), kept AS (
  SELECT m.ownership, b.mix_baseline, o.overall_avg
  FROM matched AS m
  JOIN baselines AS b ON m.order_type_mix = b.order_type_mix
  CROSS JOIN overall AS o
  WHERE m.ownership > o.overall_avg
)
SELECT AVG(ownership) AS average_ownership,
       AVG(ownership / mix_baseline) AS average_ownership_to_mix_baseline,
       AVG(ownership - overall_avg) AS average_excess_ownership
FROM kept;
